name: Skyfire
description: Identity and payments network for agents: create know-your-agent (KYA) and pay tokens so agents can verify identity and pay services in stablecoins, and sellers can charge them. MCP and API.

skills.name: Issue a Know-Your-Agent Token
skills.description: Creates a kya token carrying the agent's verified identity and its human principal, to present to services.

skills.name: Verify an Agent's Identity
skills.description: Lets sellers verify a KYA token's signature against Skyfire's JWKS and require verified agent identity for access.

skills.name: Pay with a KYAPay Token
skills.description: Creates pay or kya-pay tokens that carry payment intent, which sellers charge against the buyer agent's funded wallet.

skills.name: Discover Sellers
skills.description: Finds seller services in the Skyfire directory that an agent can access or pay through the MCP server.
